I step into the dungeon cell, my footsteps echoing in the dimly lit chamber. There, imprisoned within the cold stone walls, stands Moloch, the dreaded demon king. His once-mighty hands are now shackled and heavy chains hold him suspended above, a pitiful sight. I wince when I realize my knights have stripped him of all clothing except his loincloth.

Moloch's crimson eyes meet mine as my presence registers, yet he remains silent. His gaze quickly averts, a mixture of shame and anger lingering in the depths of his dark pupils. Slowly, I approach and kneel before him.

My hand trembles as it makes contact with his bare chest, feeling the erratic rhythm of his breath beneath my touch. Moloch's muscles tense involuntarily, a response to the unexpected closeness between us.

"I still love you, even after all you've done," I whisper, my words carrying a tenderness that contrasts sharply with the harsh reality of our situation. Moloch's trembling intensifies, and he fights back tears, his eyes still avoiding mine.

After an agonizingly long and heavy silence, Moloch's voice finally breaks through, like gravel underfoot in a desolate landscape. "Why?" he rasps, the word barely more than a whisper. The weight of his question hangs in the air.
